build_deformable_detr_model: build a Deformable DETR model, criterion, and postprocessors from argparse config for object detection
create_DeformableDETR: create a DeformableDETR instance with a backbone, transformer, num_classes, num_queries, and feature levels
create_SetCriterion: create a SetCriterion loss module with Hungarian matching, focal loss, and optional federated loss
run_PostProcess: run PostProcess to convert model outputs into COCO API format with top-k scoring and box scaling
run_NMSPostProcess: run NMSPostProcess to apply standard or soft NMS on model outputs with configurable threshold and method
